title: have we seen the same thing?
content: The mall has navy blue marble floors and walls, and wide corridors. The outside is made of glass or crystal. Sometimes I go to a department store with half its lights on and nobody’s there. One time there were clothes thrown everywhere throughout the store in huge piles. The school is “industrial” with a lot of metal. and makeshift structures. It feels like a factory except it’s very open with a courtyard. Was anybody there during the celebrations last week? A lot of people were graduating and getting huge opportunities. From the outside, the school is tall and is multiple stories high. The cafeteria feels like an elementary school cafeteria where it had those long tables and bright cool toned lights. The airport is small and I am always waiting in line with luggage. The carpet is gray and it feels like a domestic airport but international flights are available. There is a park (?) that holds festivals and I saw a huge mermaid lady in the middle of the lake there that was on display. There is a resort with a huge pool area that is slightly covered because there are structures coming out of the water that are of course connected to the hotel/resort. The resort also has underground tunnels. It’s always nighttime when I’m inside of the hotel area but day time at the pool. Crime always seems to take place here
